title: Target Knockdown
description: Set up three safe targets and try to roll or strike your ball into them. Count every clean hit and try to improve your score.
target: Hit a target 10 times from 20 attempts

title: Around the Body
description: Move the ball around your waist and through your legs in a figure eight. Stay balanced and keep the ball under control.
target: Complete 10 circles each way and 10 figure eights

title: Balance Explorer
description: Balance a beanbag or rolled-up pair of socks while walking slowly. Try a different safe body position each round.
target: Complete 4 x 20-second balance rounds without dropping it

title: Passing Streak
description: Pass with a partner or against a safe wall target. Keep your passes controlled and see how long your accurate streak can last.
target: Complete 20 accurate passes, including a streak of 5

title: Move the Big Ball
description: Use controlled strikes or rolls to move a large soft ball across a safe line. Aim carefully rather than using maximum force.
target: Move the large ball across the line in 15 accurate attempts or fewer
